implementation: Added a project activity lock around run creation and finalization. Only one active run can be admitted; malformed/unknown active records fail closed. Read-only list/show remains available.

Foreground try/train/evaluate records supervisor PID and start token. Before new admission, the application reconciles verifiably dead supervisors to interrupted, preserving inputs and checkpoints. Missing supervisor identity stays protected.

Before importing any user model/data/training/evaluator module, the worker snapshots project-local Python files under the run directory, checks each file remained stable during copy, stores a SHA-256 manifest, and imports from read-only snapshot files. Source manifests map snapshot bytes back to stable project paths, so repeat/resume/evaluate compare content rather than per-run snapshot paths.

Immutable input JSON remains separate from renameable run metadata. Existing parent/child lineage and secret redaction/replay-required behavior remain intact. Environment distribution evidence is recorded; dataset entrypoint/parameters/split/seed and optional data fingerprint are preserved. No content-level data identity is claimed when a fingerprint is absent.

Coordinator integration patch: snapshot files explicitly pinned by a saved variant under `.model-maven/components` into the immutable run snapshot, verifies the exact descriptor SHA-256, and rejects descriptor drift before user code runs. Discovery remains limited to pinned JSON descriptors; arbitrary non-Python project files remain excluded.

Snapshot freezes project-local Python files. Non-Python assets and external resources are not copied; dataset content identity requires an explicit fingerprint and is reported as limited when absent.

The run snapshot originally froze only Python files while edit variants also pin registered component manifest JSON. Training with an extension-backed variant then remapped the manifest fingerprint into a nonexistent snapshot path and failed SOURCE_CHANGED. Snapshot now carries these explicitly pinned component descriptors without broadening to arbitrary data files.
